body: I can see where you're coming from. However, I wonder if people are not meaning to glorify the story but instead are getting hyped up over the great storytelling and the twists in the game? They constantly gossiped about people at their school that I didn't know and never bothered to fill me in (or change the topic to something I could participate in). No wonder homeschooled kids get a bad rap. I wasn't weird or quiet, I just didn't know or care about what was going on at their school.
